definitions.explanation: The state of being tired or weary, physically or mentally.

examples.japanese: {疲|つか}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れない→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: I can't shake off the fatigue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{疲|つか}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{癒|いや}す→癒す：13616_iyasu⟧。
examples.english: Relieve the fatigue of the day.
The tiredness shows on your face.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {疲|つか}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧ (fatigue goes away, to feel refreshed)
- {疲|つか}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (fatigue shows, to start feeling tired)
- {疲|つか}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{癒|いや}す→癒す：13616_iyasu⟧ (to relieve fatigue)
- {疲|つか}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel tired)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{疲|つか}れ (eye strain)
- ⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧{疲|つか}れ (mental fatigue)
- ⟦{肉体的|にくたいてき}→肉体的：06198_nikutaiteki⟧{疲|つか}れ (physical fatigue)

RELATED VERB:
- ⟦{疲|つか}れる→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧ (to get tired) - this noun is derived from the verb
